method_card.objective: Find PDB entries cross-referenced by the human PCNA UniProt record P12004.
method_card.mechanism: Supply one archive input: a gx.pcna-archive-request/1 with accession P12004 and optional entry_ids for a live UniProt query, or the original UniProt record. No method parameters.
method_card.estimator: One candidate per PDB accession; method, resolution and chain annotations copied from UniProt, preserving unknowns. These bibliographic data do not establish partner identity, apo state or coordinate eligibility.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Archive metadata and deposited coordinates; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source; archived material retains the archive terms.
manifest.licence_basis: UniProt and wwPDB supply the original metadata and the deposited coordinates.
manifest.limitations: The UniProt P12004 cross-reference list reflects its specific release. Unannotated resolution, chain coverage, partners and apo status remain unknown.
